patterns_discovered.description: View collects count statistics from multiple models using filter().count()
Use of select_related for foreign key relationships and limit with [:5] for top 5 results
Multiple queries filtering by status field using different values per model
Queries ordered by date fields (request_date, expected_delivery_date, receiving_date)
Standard Django pattern of building context dict and passing to render

gotchas_discovered.description: Statistics are calculated with separate .count() queries for each status. Could benefit from aggregation to reduce database hits
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Consider using aggregation (Count, Q objects) in a single query

gotchas_discovered.description: Status values like 'PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'SENT' are hardcoded strings without model constants
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Define status choices as model constants or use model choices definitions

gotchas_discovered.description: No error handling for database queries or missing template
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Consider try-catch for database errors or add logging

gotchas_discovered.description: Limited results with [:5] slice but no pagination mechanism for handling overflow
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Use Django paginator if more results need to be accessed

approach_outcome.description: Successfully created dashboard.py with complete dashboard view
approach_outcome.execution_notes: First attempt successful - view implements all required functionality including authentication, statistics gathering, and template rendering
approach_outcome.outcome_summary: Complete implementation of dashboard view with proper Django patterns (decorators, context, select_related optimization)

recommendations.recommendation: Refactor statistics queries to use Django aggregation (Count, Q) to reduce database round trips from 4 to 1
recommendations.impact: Improved database efficiency and reduced query overhead

recommendations.recommendation: Extract hardcoded status strings to model-level constants (e.g., PurchaseRequest.Status.PENDING)
recommendations.impact: Better maintainability and reduced typo risk

recommendations.recommendation: Add docstring parameter documentation for the context variables passed to template
recommendations.impact: Improved code documentation for future maintainers

recommendations.recommendation: Create unit tests for dashboard view covering different user roles and data scenarios
recommendations.impact: Ensures view behaves correctly with various data states and permissions
